Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.observability

Class KfeBalanceMetrics

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.observability.KfeBalanceMetrics
@Component public class KfeBalanceMetrics extends Object
Records low-cardinality Micrometer counters for balance consistency and probe policy outcomes. Every method is a no-op when no MeterRegistry is available, supporting minimal profiles.
